Card Q&A.a: Yes, it includes this card itself.
Card Q&A.q: Does "Digimon card with [Chessmon] in its name in your trash" in this card's [On Deletion] effect also include this card itself?

Effect: [On Deletion] If it's your opponent's turn, you may play 1 level 3 or lower Digimon card with [Chessmon] in its name from your hand without paying the cost. If you have 8 or more Digimon cards with [Chessmon] in their names in your trash, add 2 to the maximum level of the card this effect can play.
